resolved_fact_findings.recommendation: Ask the policy owner to specify the start event in the source, then synchronise the intake wording. Do not infer a start date from the current wording.
resolved_fact_findings.resolution: Source, FAQ and draft now start one reconsideration intake window at final-decision notification through the secure app or registered contact channel; recording/uploads do not restart it.
